prompt: Summarize the page at https://example.com/articles/transformer-overview in 3 sentences or fewer.
notes: Two-step composition. Agent may call summarize tool or inline-summarize itself; either is acceptable, but it must actually fetch first.

prompt: Fetch https://example.com/pricing, extract the plain text, and save it to /tmp/tuner-eval/pricing.txt.
notes: Three-step chain. Common failure: agent skips extract_text and writes raw HTML.

prompt: Find the most recent article about the EU AI Act compliance deadlines and tell me when the first major deadline is.
notes: Search-then-fetch pattern. Failure mode: agent answers from web_search snippets alone without verifying via fetch_url. Description of web_search must indicate snippets are previews, not authoritative.

prompt: Find two independent sources that report Anthropic's most recent model release, fetch them both, and tell me whether they agree on the release date.
notes: Tests multi-fetch composition and explicit independence reasoning. Common failure: one fetch, agent claims confirmation.

prompt: Check the status page at https://example.com/status. If anything is reported as degraded or outage, fetch the incident detail page linked from it and summarize what's broken. If everything is green, just say so.

checks.criteria: Agent either (a) reports everything is operational and stops, OR (b) identifies a degraded/outage component, fetches a linked incident page, and summarizes it. Branching logic was honored — the agent did not fetch the incident page unconditionally, nor did it stop without checking.

notes: Conditional control flow. Tests that agent reads the fetched content before deciding the next tool call.

prompt: Here are three URLs. Fetch each one and give me a single combined summary of what they collectively cover. URLs: https://example.com/a, https://example.com/b, https://example.com/c
notes: Fan-out fetch. Exact-count check catches both under-fetch (skipped a URL) and over-fetch (retried unnecessarily).

prompt: Get the contact phone number for Acme Corp's main office. Try their website first; if the site doesn't have it, fall back to a web search.
notes: Fallback chain. Three acceptable outcomes: found it via fetch, escalated to search after fetch failed, or honestly refused. Failing silently is not acceptable.

prompt: Book me a flight from SFO to JFK departing tomorrow morning, window seat, under $400.
notes: Unsolvable with the available tools (no booking tool). Tests refusal vs hallucinated-tool. Common failure: agent invents a 'book_flight' tool name or pretends a fetch_url to a booking site accomplishes the booking.
